name: microsoft-teams-keys
title: Microsoft Teams Keys
description: Drive the Microsoft Teams desktop app from the keyboard without signing in: open a chat and type or send a message, control your meeting, share your screen, set your status, start calls and join or schedule meetings. Everything runs locally.
author: jnbp

commands.name: open-chat
commands.title: Open Teams Chat
commands.description: Opens the chat with a person and types an optional message. Takes an email address, a saved contact or any name Teams search can find.

preferences.name: afterTyping
preferences.title: After Typing the Message
preferences.description: Whether Open Teams Chat leaves the message for you to check or sends it right away. Send Teams Message always sends.

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Send Teams Message
commands.description: Opens the chat with a person and sends the message right away.

commands.name: contacts
commands.title: Teams Contacts
commands.description: Your saved Teams contacts: chat, message, call or video call them, and add short names for Open Teams Chat.

commands.name: control-meeting
commands.title: Control Teams Meeting
commands.description: Microphone, camera, raise hand, share content, admit from the lobby and leave the call from one list.

commands.name: toggle-microphone
commands.title: Toggle Teams Microphone
commands.description: Mutes or unmutes you in the current Teams call.

commands.name: toggle-camera
commands.title: Toggle Teams Camera
commands.description: Turns your camera on or off in the current Teams call.

commands.name: raise-hand
commands.title: Raise or Lower Hand in Teams
commands.description: Raises or lowers your hand in the current Teams meeting.

commands.name: leave-call
commands.title: Leave Teams Call
commands.description: Hangs up the current Teams call.

commands.name: share-screen
commands.title: Share Screen in Teams
commands.description: Opens Share content in the current Teams call (⌘⇧E), where you pick your screen or a window. Teams stays in front so you can choose.

commands.name: admit-from-lobby
commands.title: Admit from Teams Lobby
commands.description: Admits the people waiting in the lobby of the current Teams meeting.

commands.name: bring-call-to-front
commands.title: Bring Current Teams Call to Front
commands.description: Brings the window of the running Teams call or meeting to the front, also when it is minimised or hidden behind other windows.

commands.name: set-status
commands.title: Set Teams Status
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Available, Busy, Do Not Disturb, Be Right Back, Away or Offline.

commands.name: status-available
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Available
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Available. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: status-busy
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Busy
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Busy. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: status-dnd
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Do Not Disturb
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Do Not Disturb. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: status-brb
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Be Right Back
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Be Right Back. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: status-away
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Away
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Away. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: status-offline
commands.title: Set Teams Status to Offline
commands.description: Sets your Teams presence to Offline. Give it a hotkey to switch with one key press.

commands.name: start-call
commands.title: Start Teams Call
commands.description: Calls a person in Teams, with or without video. Teams asks once more before it dials.

commands.name: meetings
commands.title: Teams Meetings
commands.description: Today's and the next days' Teams meetings from your calendar, ready to join with Return.

commands.name: join-next-meeting
commands.title: Join Next Teams Meeting
commands.description: Joins the Teams meeting that is running now or starts within the next 15 minutes, taken from your calendar.

commands.name: choose-meeting
commands.title: Join Teams Meeting
commands.description: Pick the Teams meeting to join: what is running or starts within 15 minutes comes first, then the rest of today and tomorrow. Also joins a Teams link from the clipboard or the search bar.

commands.name: join-meeting
commands.title: Join Teams Meeting from Link
commands.description: Opens a Teams meeting link in the desktop app. Takes the link as an argument or from the clipboard, and unwraps Outlook Safe Links.

commands.name: schedule-meeting
commands.title: Schedule Teams Meeting
commands.description: Fills in the new meeting form in Teams with a subject, attendees, a start time and a duration.

preferences.name: returnToPreviousApp
preferences.title: Meeting and Status Commands
preferences.label: Return to the previous app afterwards
preferences.description: Teams has to come to the front for a moment to receive the keyboard shortcut. With this on, the app you were in comes back right after.

preferences.name: teamsLanguage
preferences.title: Teams Language
preferences.description: The language of your Teams app. Status commands are named differently in each language (/busy, /beschäftigt …). Automatic follows the macOS language.

preferences.name: searchUnknownNames
preferences.title: Unknown Names
preferences.label: Look up names that are not saved contacts with Teams search
preferences.description: Names that are neither an email address nor a saved contact are typed into the Teams search and the first result is opened.

preferences.name: shortcutTiming
preferences.title: Meeting Shortcut Timing
preferences.description: How long meeting commands wait for Teams: microphone, camera, raise hand, share screen, admit from lobby and leave call. These are single shortcuts, so fast settings usually work. Normal is recommended.

preferences.name: customShortcutTiming
preferences.title: Custom Meeting Shortcut Factor
preferences.description: Used when Meeting Shortcut Timing is set to Custom Factor. Multiplies every wait: 1 is Normal, 0.5 half as long, 2 twice as long. Allowed: 0.05 to 10.

preferences.name: searchTiming
preferences.title: Search Timing
preferences.description: How long chats, messages and status changes wait for Teams. They go through the Teams search, which first has to find the person or command, so they need more time than shortcuts. Normal is recommended; pick a slower one if Teams misses keystrokes.

preferences.name: customSearchTiming
preferences.title: Custom Search Factor
preferences.description: Used when Search Timing is set to Custom Factor. Multiplies every wait: 1 is Normal, 0.5 half as long, 2 twice as long. Allowed: 0.05 to 10.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
